legal_name: System One (private; investors include funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management and StepStone Group)
target_audience: Your target customers are telecom networks, energy companies, data centre operators and life sciences companies, and leaders from each are in Formula 1: AT&T (Red Bull), Shell (Ferrari), Core Scientific (Cadillac), Schneider Electric (McLaren) and AbbVie (McLaren). B2B brands are in the sport to host key clients, show their technology working under pressure and meet buyers worldwide. Teams also introduce partners to each other, to their owners and boards, and run joint activations at forums like Mobile World Congress and Davos.
market_overlap: System One works from more than 50 locations across the US, Canada, the UK and Brazil, and is buying firms that serve data centre, telecom and power projects. The Formula 1 calendar aligns with the markets you are present in and expanding into: Miami, Montreal, Silverstone, Austin, Sao Paulo and Las Vegas.
market_reference: Akkodis, part of the Adecco Group and your direct competitor in engineering and technology talent, has been an Official Team Partner of Mercedes since the start of the 2022 season. It supplies the team with IT and engineering expertise and access to digital engineering talent, so its own people and services work inside a Formula 1 team.
shared_values: A Formula 1 team needs skilled engineers and technicians in the right place on time, every race weekend. System One supplies engineers, technicians and IT specialists to keep power, telecom and data centre projects on schedule.
flags: Capacity: soft note. Private equity owned (its fourth PE partner); about 1.5bn USD revenue (CEO bio on systemone.com) and more than 10,000 people; Oaktree renewed and StepStone joined in a new investment on 1 Sept 2026 (terms not disclosed, Moelis advised). Staffing margins are thin and the business is mostly US.

target_audience: Your target customers are small and mid-sized employers, reached directly and through banks, accounting firms, benefits brokers and HR software platforms, and leaders from each channel are in Formula 1: Barclays (Williams), Deloitte (McLaren), Aon (Ferrari) and Workday (McLaren). B2B brands are in the sport to host key clients, show their technology working under pressure and meet buyers worldwide. Teams also introduce partners to each other, to their owners and boards, and run joint activations at forums like Money20/20 and AWS re:Invent.
market_overlap: Asure serves more than 100,000 businesses across the US, directly and through resellers, and is adding mid-market payroll clients in the southeast through an October 2026 acquisition. The Formula 1 calendar aligns with the markets you are present in and expanding into: Miami, Austin and Las Vegas.
market_reference: UKG, your direct competitor in payroll and HR software, became Aston Martin's Official HR, Pay and Workforce Management Partner in November 2025 on a multi-year deal. UKG supplies its HR, pay and workforce management platform to the team, which gives UKG a reference customer in Formula 1.
shared_values: A Formula 1 team must meet every technical and financial rule, every race, without error. Asure helps small and mid-sized businesses do the same with payroll, tax filing and HR compliance, every pay cycle.
flags: Capacity: hard caution. Nasdaq-listed small cap; FY2026 revenue guidance 162-164M USD and adjusted EBITDA guidance 40-42M USD; Q3 2026 net loss 0.6M USD; cash 16.8M USD excluding client funds at 30 Sept 2026; new credit facility of up to 115M USD led by MUFG (Oct 2026) used to repay MidCap and fund a 26.5M USD acquisition (SEC 8-K exhibit 99.1, 29 Oct 2026). A 4M USD a year deal would be about 10% of adjusted EBITDA. Matches the sheet note.
Co-activation angle: Asure sells through AWS Marketplace (AWS is a Formula 1 series partner) and Oracle Marketplace (Oracle is Red Bull's title partner), per the Q3 2026 release.
Grid availability: HR and pay software is held by Workday (McLaren) and UKG (Aston Martin); benefits software by Businessolver (Alpine); expense software by Emburse (Haas).

Grid names are sector leaders in Asure's partner channels (asuresoftware.com lists CPAs and accountants, benefit brokers, banks and HCM platforms), not confirmed Asure partners. Small and mid-sized employers themselves have no honest grid example, so the sentence names the channels.

Same category as TriNet, Personio and DailyPay in this batch (HR and pay); TriNet's email uses the same UKG reference: send separately; designations differ.
